::: {.callout-tip}
## Learning Goals {.unnumbered}

By the end of this tutorial, you should be able to:

- Identify the base URL, path, and query parameters in an API request.
- Construct and send an API request in R using `httr2`.
- Write a function that changes selected parts of an API request.
- Use `map()` and `map2()` to repeat API requests across multiple inputs.
:::
